decisive_items: Each episode featured subjective perioral swelling, hypotension within her baseline range, and stridor that resolved without objective edema
She continued to experience suicidal ideation and auditory hallucinations and was started on aripiprazole
response.rationale: Repeated episodes lack objective edema, normal tryptase and laryngoscopy, with prominent psychiatric comorbidity and functional disability, favoring somatoform disorder over factitious disorder (no evidence of deliberate deception) or organic causes.

rejected.why: No evidence of intentional symptom production or external incentives; symptoms align with unconscious somatic expression.
Normal serial tryptase and equivocal marrow without supporting mediator elevation argue against mastocytosis.
Hereditary angioedema testing was normal and episodes lacked objective angioedema.
